verses.original: ה֥וֹי הָעִ֖יר הַיּוֹנָֽה׃ מֹרְאָ֖ה וְנִגְאָלָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: hō·w hā·‘îr hay·yō·w·nāh mō·rə·’āh wə·niḡ·’ā·lāh
verses.literal: Woe to the city of oppressors rebellious and defiled

verses.original: שָֽׁמְעָה֙ לֹ֤א בְּק֔וֹל לָקְחָ֖ה לֹ֥א מוּסָ֑ר לֹ֣א בָטָ֔חָה בַּֽיהוָה֙ לֹ֥א קָרֵֽבָה׃ אֶל־ אֱלֹהֶ֖יהָ
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·‘āh lō bə·qō·wl lā·qə·ḥāh lō mū·sār lō ḇā·ṭā·ḥāh Yah·weh lō qā·rê·ḇāh ’el- ’ĕ·lō·he·hā
verses.literal: She heeded no voice she accepted no correction She does not trust in the LORD she has not drawn near to her God

verses.original: שָׂרֶ֣יהָ בְקִרְבָּ֔הּ שֹֽׁאֲגִ֑ים אֲרָי֖וֹת שֹׁפְטֶ֙יהָ֙ עֶ֔רֶב זְאֵ֣בֵי גָרְמ֖וּ לֹ֥א לַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: śā·re·hā ḇə·qir·bāh šō·’ă·ḡîm ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ šō·p̄ə·ṭe·hā ‘e·reḇ zə·’ê·ḇê ḡā·rə·mū lō lab·bō·qer
verses.literal: Her princes - are roaring lions her judges [are] evening wolves leaving nothing for the morning

verses.original: נְבִיאֶ֙יהָ֙ פֹּֽחֲזִ֔ים בֹּֽגְד֑וֹת אַנְשֵׁ֖י כֹּהֲנֶ֙יהָ֙ חִלְּלוּ־ קֹ֔דֶשׁ חָמְס֖וּ תּוֹרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ḇî·’e·hā pō·ḥă·zîm bō·ḡə·ḏō·wṯ ’an·šê kō·hă·ne·hā ḥil·lə·lū- qō·ḏeš ḥā·mə·sū tō·w·rāh
verses.literal: Her prophets are reckless faithless men Her priests profane the sanctuary they do violence to the law

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה בְּקִרְבָּ֔הּ צַדִּיק֙ יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לֹ֥א עַוְלָ֑ה יִתֵּ֤ן מִשְׁפָּט֨וֹ בַּבֹּ֨קֶר בַּבֹּ֜קֶר לֹ֣א נֶעְדָּ֔ר לָאוֹר֙ עַוָּ֖ל יוֹדֵ֥עַ וְלֹֽא־ בֹּֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bə·qir·bāh ṣad·dîq ya·‘ă·śeh lō ‘aw·lāh yit·tên miš·pā·ṭōw bab·bō·qer bab·bō·qer lō ne‘·dār lā·’ō·wr ‘aw·wāl yō·w·ḏê·a‘ wə·lō- bō·šeṯ
verses.literal: The LORD within her is righteous He does no wrong He applies His justice morning by morning He does not fail at dawn yet the unjust know no shame

verses.original: הִכְרַ֣תִּי גוֹיִ֗ם פִּנּוֹתָ֔ם נָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ הֶחֱרַ֥בְתִּי חֽוּצוֹתָ֖ם מִבְּלִ֣י עוֹבֵ֑ר עָרֵיהֶ֛ם נִצְדּ֧וּ מִבְּלִי־ אִ֖ישׁ מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: hiḵ·rat·tî ḡō·w·yim pin·nō·w·ṯām nā·šam·mū he·ḥĕ·raḇ·tî ḥū·ṣō·w·ṯām mib·bə·lî ‘ō·w·ḇêr ‘ā·rê·hem niṣ·dū mib·bə·lî- ’îš mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ
verses.literal: I have cut off the nations their corner towers are destroyed I have made their streets {deserted} with no one to pass through Their cities are laid waste with no man no inhabitant

verses.original: אָמַ֜רְתִּי אַךְ־ תִּירְאִ֤י אוֹתִי֙ תִּקְחִ֣י מוּסָ֔ר מְעוֹנָ֔הּ וְלֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֣ת כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ פָּקַ֖דְתִּי עָלֶ֑יהָ אָכֵן֙ הִשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ הִשְׁחִ֔יתוּ כֹּ֖ל עֲלִילוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar·tî ’aḵ- tî·rə·’î ’ō·w·ṯî tiq·ḥî mū·sār mə·‘ō·w·nāh wə·lō- yik·kā·rêṯ kōl ’ă·šer- pā·qaḏ·tî ‘ā·le·hā ’ā·ḵên hiš·kî·mū hiš·ḥî·ṯū kōl ‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: I said Surely you will fear Me and accept correction Then her dwelling place would not be cut off [despite] all for which I punished her But they rose early to corrupt all their deeds

verses.original: לָכֵ֤ן חַכּוּ־ לִי֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה לְי֖וֹם קוּמִ֣י לְעַ֑ד כִּ֣י מִשְׁפָּטִי֩ לֶאֱסֹ֨ף גּוֹיִ֜ם לְקָבְצִ֣י מַמְלָכ֗וֹת לִשְׁפֹּ֨ךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם זַעְמִי֙ כֹּ֚ל חֲר֣וֹן אַפִּ֔י כִּ֚י כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ תֵּאָכֵ֖ל בְּאֵ֣שׁ קִנְאָתִ֔י
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ḥak·kū- lî nə·’um- Yah·weh lə·yō·wm qū·mî lə·‘aḏ kî miš·pā·ṭî le·’ĕ·sōp̄ gō·w·yim lə·qā·ḇə·ṣî mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ liš·pōḵ ‘ă·lê·hem za‘·mî kōl ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pî kî kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ tê·’ā·ḵêl bə·’êš qin·’ā·ṯî
verses.literal: Therefore wait for Me declares the LORD until the day I rise to testify For My decision is to gather nations to assemble kingdoms to pour out upon them My indignation all My burning anger . . . For all the earth will be consumed by the fire of My jealousy

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אָ֛ז אֶהְפֹּ֥ךְ בְרוּרָ֑ה שָׂפָ֣ה אֶל־ עַמִּ֖ים כֻלָּם֙ לִקְרֹ֤א בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה לְעָבְד֖וֹ שְׁכֶ֥ם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’āz ’eh·pōḵ ḇə·rū·rāh śā·p̄āh ’el- ‘am·mîm ḵul·lām liq·rō bə·šêm Yah·weh lə·‘ā·ḇə·ḏōw šə·ḵem ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: For then I will restore pure lips to the peoples that all may call upon the name of the LORD and serve Him shoulder to shoulder

verses.original: מֵעֵ֖בֶר לְנַֽהֲרֵי־ כ֑וּשׁ עֲתָרַי֙ פוּצַ֔י בַּת־ יוֹבִל֖וּן מִנְחָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ê·ḇer lə·na·hă·rê- ḵūš ‘ă·ṯā·ray p̄ū·ṣay baṯ- yō·w·ḇi·lūn min·ḥā·ṯî
verses.literal: From beyond the rivers of Cush My worshipers My scattered people will bring Me an offering

verses.original: הַה֗וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם לֹ֤א תֵב֙וֹשִׁי֙ מִכֹּ֣ל עֲלִילֹתַ֔יִךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּשַׁ֖עַתְּ בִּ֑י כִּי־ אָ֣ז׀ אָסִ֣יר מִקִּרְבֵּ֗ךְ עַלִּיזֵי֙ גַּאֲוָתֵ֔ךְ וְלֹֽא־ תוֹסִ֧פִי ע֖וֹד לְגָבְהָ֛ה קָדְשִֽׁי׃ בְּהַ֥ר
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm lō ṯê·ḇō·wō·šî mik·kōl ‘ă·lî·lō·ṯa·yiḵ ’ă·šer pā·ša·‘at bî kî- ’āz ’ā·sîr miq·qir·bêḵ ‘al·lî·zê ga·’ă·wā·ṯêḵ wə·lō- ṯō·w·si·p̄î ‘ō·wḏ lə·ḡā·ḇə·hāh qāḏ·šî bə·har
verses.literal: On that day you will not be put to shame for any of the deeds by which you have transgressed against Me For then I will remove from among you those who rejoice in their pride and you will never again . . . be haughty on My holy mountain

verses.original: וְהִשְׁאַרְתִּ֣י בְקִרְבֵּ֔ךְ עָנִ֖י וָדָ֑ל עַ֥ם וְחָס֖וּ בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·’ar·tî ḇə·qir·bêḵ ‘ā·nî wā·ḏāl ‘am wə·ḥā·sū bə·šêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: But I will leave within you a meek and humble people and they will trust in the name of the LORD

verses.original: שְׁאֵרִ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֹֽא־ יַעֲשׂ֤וּ עַוְלָה֙ וְלֹא־ יְדַבְּר֣וּ כָזָ֔ב וְלֹֽא־ תַּרְמִ֑ית לְשׁ֣וֹן יִמָּצֵ֥א בְּפִיהֶ֖ם כִּֽי־ הֵ֛מָּה יִרְע֥וּ וְרָבְצ֖וּ וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃ס
verses.transliteration: šə·’ê·rîṯ yiś·rā·’êl lō- ya·‘ă·śū ‘aw·lāh wə·lō- yə·ḏab·bə·rū ḵā·zāḇ wə·lō- tar·mîṯ lə·šō·wn yim·mā·ṣê bə·p̄î·hem kî- hêm·māh yir·‘ū wə·rā·ḇə·ṣū wə·’ên ma·ḥă·rîḏ
verses.literal: The remnant of Israel will no longer do wrong [or] speak lies nor will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouths But they will feed and lie down with no one to make them tremble

verses.original: רָנִּי֙ בַּת־ צִיּ֔וֹן הָרִ֖יעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל שִׂמְחִ֤י וְעָלְזִי֙ בְּכָל־ לֵ֔ב בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: rān·nî baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn hā·rî·‘ū yiś·rā·’êl śim·ḥî wə·‘ā·lə·zî bə·ḵāl lêḇ baṯ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Sing for joy O Daughter of Zion shout aloud O Israel Be glad and rejoice with all your heart O Daughter of Jerusalem

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ הֵסִ֤יר מִשְׁפָּטַ֔יִךְ פִּנָּ֖ה אֹֽיְבֵ֑ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל׀ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוָה֙ בְּקִרְבֵּ֔ךְ לֹא־ עֽוֹד׃ תִֽירְאִ֥י רָ֖ע
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hê·sîr miš·pā·ṭa·yiḵ pin·nāh ’ō·yə·ḇêḵ yiś·rā·’êl me·leḵ Yah·weh bə·qir·bêḵ lō- ‘ō·wḏ ṯî·rə·’î rā‘
verses.literal: The LORD has taken away your punishment He has turned back your enemy Israel’s King the LORD is among you no longer will you fear any harm

verses.original: הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם יֵאָמֵ֥ר לִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אַל־ תִּירָ֑אִי צִיּ֖וֹן אַל־ יָדָֽיִךְ׃ יִרְפּ֥וּ
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm yê·’ā·mêr lî·rū·šā·lim ’al- tî·rā·’î ṣî·yō·wn ’al- yā·ḏā·yiḵ yir·pū
verses.literal: On that day they will say to Jerusalem Do not fear O Zion do not let your hands fall limp

verses.original: יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛יִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ך גִּבּ֣וֹר יוֹשִׁ֑יעַ יָשִׂ֨ישׂ עָלַ֜יִךְ בְּשִׂמְחָ֗ה יַחֲרִישׁ֙ בְּאַ֣הֲבָת֔וֹ יָגִ֥יל עָלַ֖יִךְ בְּרִנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·ha·yiḵ bə·qir·bēḵ gib·bō·wr yō·wō·šî·a‘ yā·śîś ‘ā·la·yiḵ bə·śim·ḥāh ya·ḥă·rîš bə·’a·hă·ḇā·ṯōw yā·ḡîl ‘ā·la·yiḵ bə·rin·nāh
verses.literal: The LORD your God is among you He is mighty to save He will rejoice over you with gladness He will quiet [you] with His love He will rejoice over you with singing

verses.original: אָסַ֖פְתִּי מִמֵּ֣ךְ נוּגֵ֧י מִמּוֹעֵ֛ד הָי֑וּ מַשְׂאֵ֥ת חֶרְפָּֽה׃ עָלֶ֖יהָ
verses.transliteration: ’ā·sap̄·tî mim·mêḵ nū·ḡê mim·mō·w·‘êḏ hā·yū maś·’êṯ ḥer·pāh ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: I will gather those among you who grieve over the appointed feasts so that you will no longer suffer reproach

verses.original: הִנְנִ֥י הַהִ֑יא בָּעֵ֣ת עֹשֶׂ֛ה אֶת־ כָּל־ מְעַנַּ֖יִךְ וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶת־ הַצֹּלֵעָ֗ה אֲקַבֵּ֔ץ וְהַנִּדָּחָה֙ וְשַׂמְתִּים֙ לִתְהִלָּ֣ה וּלְשֵׁ֔ם בָּשְׁתָּֽם׃ בְּכָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ha·hî bā·‘êṯ ‘ō·śeh ’eṯ- kāl- mə·‘an·na·yiḵ wə·hō·wō·ša‘·tî ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣō·lê·‘āh ’ă·qab·bêṣ wə·han·nid·dā·ḥāh wə·śam·tîm liṯ·hil·lāh ū·lə·šêm bā·šə·tām bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Behold at that time I will deal - with all who afflict you I will save - the lame and gather the scattered and I will appoint praise and fame for the disgraced throughout the earth

verses.original: הַהִיא֙ בָּעֵ֤ת אָבִ֣יא אֶתְכֶ֔ם וּבָעֵ֖ת קַבְּצִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶתְכֶ֜ם לְשֵׁ֣ם וְלִתְהִלָּ֗ה בְּכֹל֙ עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּשׁוּבִ֧י אֶת־ שְׁבוּתֵיכֶ֛ם לְעֵינֵיכֶ֖ם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hî bā·‘êṯ ’ā·ḇî ’eṯ·ḵem ū·ḇā·‘êṯ qab·bə·ṣî ’eṯ·ḵem kî- ’et·tên ’eṯ·ḵem lə·šêm wə·liṯ·hil·lāh bə·ḵōl ‘am·mê hā·’ā·reṣ bə·šū·ḇî ’eṯ- šə·ḇū·ṯê·ḵem lə·‘ê·nê·ḵem ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: At that time I will bring you in yes, at that time I will gather you For I will give you fame and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore - your captives before your very eyes says the LORD
